text: Let me start runs for all pages, using the others as comparison pages.
Still waiting on the NACA page run; I'll keep polling it.
Waiting on the last run, the missions 5.D check. I'll poll it again.
Still waiting on the missions 5.D run. One more poll.

I tested all five pages. Of the 21 criterion–page combinations that depend on page-to-page comparison or judgment, many are still NEEDS_REVIEW. These results come from an automated Trusted Tester process and are not a certified Trusted Tester result.

**Failures**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks fails on 4 of the 5 pages.** Careers, Missions, Artemis III and KSC History have no skip link or other way to jump past the repeated header. On the NACA page the tool only tried the first 8 possible skip mechanisms, so I left it as NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions fails on all 5 pages.** The header "Search" box has only gray placeholder text as its label, which disappears once you type.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible fails on Artemis III and the NACA page.**
  - On Artemis III, "Hide player controls" shows no change when it gets focus.
  - On the NACA page the tool confirmed a failure on at least one element but did not name which one. The per-element detail is in report 20261106T131657Z-f6ac54.
- **1.3.1 and 4.1.2 for form fields: the Missions page fails 1.3.1.** The checkboxes under headings like "MISSION STATUS" are not grouped with a fieldset or group label. The tool also flags each of them as lacking a connected heading. For 4.1.2 I left Missions as NEEDS_REVIEW, because the checkbox names themselves look fine.

**Passes** are the same on every page where they apply:
- 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation and 3.2.4 Consistent Identification pass on all five pages.
- 3.2.1 On Focus passes on all pages except Careers, where a link's focus jumped once and not on retry.
- 2.1.1 Keyboard passes on Careers, Missions and KSC History. It is NEEDS_REVIEW on Artemis III and the NACA page because they have embedded video frames the tool couldn't read.

**NEEDS_REVIEW and open items**
- **2.4.3 Focus Order** is NEEDS_REVIEW on all pages, because I couldn't tell whether the out-of-order jumps matter.
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways** is NEEDS_REVIEW on all pages. The tool found site search and a footer Sitemap link, but its automated check couldn't confirm that more than one way reaches each page.
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide** is NEEDS_REVIEW everywhere, because the pages run long timers a person should watch. On the NACA page, moving or pulsing content also needs a human to judge whether it is essential.
- **Careers 2.4.7 and KSC History 2.4.7** are NEEDS_REVIEW because the focus indicators couldn't be compared clearly.
- **Missions 3.2.2 On Input** is NEEDS_REVIEW because the Missions 5.D run was still going when I stopped waiting (98 form fields, too many for a normal run).
- **Missions 3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4** are NEEDS_REVIEW because the Missions filter form is sent to a server whose responses I couldn't see.
- **The 5 follow-up 19.A runs** weren't all completed. The one that finished (NACA) didn't change the result.
- **I made two judgment calls that shaped results.** I marked the section-menu buttons ("Artemis" vs "Featured Careers") as page-specific rather than inconsistent, so 3.2.4 passes. I also marked 2.4.6 NEEDS_REVIEW instead of the tool's DNA on Careers and KSC History, since their search box has only a placeholder.
